create_SGDScheduleFree_optimizer: create a Schedule-Free SGD optimizer with configurable momentum, weight decay, and warmup steps
run_SGDScheduleFree_step: run a single optimization step with optional closure for loss computation
switch_SGDScheduleFree_eval: switch the optimizer to eval mode to compute the averaged model for evaluation
switch_SGDScheduleFree_train: switch the optimizer to train mode to resume training with the current model
configure_SGDScheduleFree_warmup: configure linear learning rate warmup with polynomial weighting in the average
